title: Warn in the update receipt when a revise drops or changes a binding that a carried failing evaluation judged
outcome: Warn in the update receipt when a revise drops or changes a binding that a carried failing evaluation judged
acceptance: When `update` drops or changes a criterion's binding that the newest or carried failing evaluation judged, the receipt names that evaluation record and states that the failure stays carried and a host may refuse or fail the next evaluation
No such notice appears when the revise leaves every judged binding unchanged
Tests cover an explicit binding drop, a binding change, and an unchanged binding
